d:
Noticing that the kids spend all their time glued to video games and mobile phones, Champaklal and the society elders organize a day of traditional childhood games in the compound—including Stapoo (Chippi), Lattu (spinning top), and Rumal Daav—to teach them the joy and health benefits of outdoor play.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
